name: 像素共生矩阵
description: 分析 co-occurrence statistics of adjacent pixel differences 以检测 overly smooth 梯度 transitions characteristic of AI生成的 images.
mechanism: Constructs co-occurrence matrices from horizontal and vertical pixel difference pairs. 测量 熵 of these matrices to quantify the diversity of micro-transitions. AI images typically show lower 熵 due to smoother, more predictable 梯度 transitions.
parameters: Difference pairs: horizontal + vertical, Quantization: 8-bit, Matrix size: 256×256, Metric: joint 熵
accuracy: 中等 — 68-80%，对检测合成平滑度有效
source: Fridrich & Kodovský (2012) — Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Detecting synthetic micro-texture smoothness in AI生成的 content

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovský, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Captures micro-level pixel relationships
• Based on well-established steg分析 research
• 检测 subtle smoothness 模式
• Works 跨 multiple image formats
limitations:
• 计算密集 for large images
• May miss global structural 异常
• 对JPEG压缩伪影敏感
• Reduced effectiveness on very small images
